changes.old: Medium shot at a public square in 1907, an anonymous adult studies a small stationary cottage from the square path, soft overcast light
changes.new: Medium shot on a San Francisco public square in June 1907, one fully grown middle-aged resident with a lined face, broad adult shoulders, a plain early-1900s wool coat and brimmed hat studies a small stationary wooden relief cottage from a gravel path, soft overcast light

changes.old: Wide shot at a public square in 1907, an anonymous park worker points toward a row of plain cottages, muted afternoon light
changes.new: Wide shot on a San Francisco public square in June 1907, one fully grown resident with a mature face in a plain early-1900s coat and brimmed hat places a hand on the doorway of a small stationary wooden relief cottage among a row of cottages, muted overcast light

changes.old: Medium shot at a refuge after the 1906 fire, an unnamed resident shields their eyes beside a distant smoke plume, soft grey daylight
changes.new: Medium shot on a San Francisco street on the morning of 18 April 1906, one fully grown resident with mature facial creases in a plain early-1900s wool coat shades his eyes while looking toward a distant plume of fire smoke, soft grey daylight
